functional_rationale: Buek plus an inanimate noun is directly attested for a batch/group of bamboo objects. Applied here to the editable collection of image assets, it is a contextual authored working-assembly description, not a flattened PNG noun or a claimed established software term.

The two working-state messages explicitly say data: collection state is serialized to project.json, while PNG output has separately nominated PNG-specific messages. Data reading here includes interpreting and validating the saved state, not a claim that an operating-system byte-read always failed.

The source-image message names one unusable picture. Its actual require guard checks both that the referenced file is an ordinary file and that its canonical parent is the assembly directory. The functional unavailable-picture wording covers both absent files and invalid outside-directory references, without claiming the physical file was deleted. It does not claim every image is unusable or the assembled PNG disappeared.

sources.title: Yungzanh: Ganjguh Dinghdan Doxgaiq Faexcuk Gai Ok Guek

sources.binding: Own primary report uses buek with manufactured bamboo objects and subsequently refers to that same batch/group. Establishes an inanimate collective, not a human-only group classifier. Candidate does not add an unsupported aen before buek. Transfer to editable pictures is authored composition.

sources.title: Boux Ndaw Laep Riuj Daeng
sources.author: Lanz Yejcinh; translator Vangz Gyanghmyauz
sources.exact_excerpt: seizneix vangjyieb gou cungj yungh mbouj ndaej
sources.binding: The parallel Chinese states that even now the narrator cannot use webpages because the computer version is too old. Direct own-language digital inability uses yungh mbouj ndaej. Candidate changes the explicit object/topic to one image and omits the contextually supplied agent. Patient negative-ability construction has separate primary grammatical support. This is not a prohibition or a claim of permanent unusability.

sources.title: Dahcej Sanhsanh / 三山姐姐

callers.AssemblyActivity.kt224–230: Import finishBatch invokes assembly.add(items). Exception uses its message or this store fallback, then discards newly imported items; candidate does not promise imported inputs retained on this exception.
callers.ImageAssembly.kt233–255: change validates state, writes project.json with image/crop/attachment/position metadata before updating history/state. AtomicFile failWrite on write failure. Data naming fits editable stored collection, not rendered PNG.
Saved state is opened and parsed into the image collection; read or state validation exceptions prevent interface setup and are included in %1$s. Functional cannot-read includes interpreting invalid stored data, not only raw file-I/O failure.
callers.ImageAssembly.kt261–262: Missing source message requires canonical parent equal assembly directory AND file.isFile; a non-file or disallowed external reference makes this source unavailable. No implication of actual deletion.

review_questions: Check buek plus image category as contextual working collection; do not approve a general flattened-output or assembly noun.
Is saved-data reading, interpreted as parsing/validating the collection, sufficient for the constructor failure? The detail slot preserves its actual cause.

Is one picture cannot be used an adequate functional rendering of absent or invalidly referenced source image, rather than a misleading all-images failure? Patient negative ability must remain distinct from a prohibition.
Refresh latest original/current/accepted/frozen guards, exact attrs and %1$s; this local absence check only covers merged292 and nomination69.
